# deploy

Deployment-specific host integration assets for the production-oriented runtime surface.

This folder is where service-manager files, host-level environment templates, and deployment-adjacent integration assets live after they have been separated from local development helpers.

- Use `systemd/README.md` for the Linux service-unit setup flow.
- Keep local workstation launchers under `scripts/local/` instead of treating `deploy/` as a generic startup folder.
